about: Tag glossary for Release Ledger. One entry per tag: the name readers see, the group it is filed under (see TAG_GROUPS in config/taxonomy.mjs) and a one-line explanation for its tag page. The daily compile adds an entry for every new tag it uses and never overwrites an existing one, so edits here stick. Aliases fold a duplicate tag into the one that is kept.

a2a.label: A2A (Agent-to-Agent protocol)
a2a.description: A protocol that lets one AI agent hand structured tasks to another; administrators care because it is a route by which agents reach Work IQ and Microsoft 365 data.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Features that help people with disabilities take part in Microsoft 365 services, such as captions and sign language interpretation. Admins care because policies can switch them on or off.

accounting.label: Accounting
accounting.description: Copilot capabilities for accounting work such as reconciliations and journal entries. Administrators care because they touch financial records.

activities.label: Activities
activities.description: Dataverse's emails, appointments, tasks and phone calls, which record who took part.

adaptive-protection.label: Adaptive Protection
adaptive-protection.description: Microsoft Purview feature that assigns insider risk levels to users and applies DLP, retention or Conditional Access controls to match; admins decide which engines react.

adaptive-scopes.label: Adaptive scopes
adaptive-scopes.description: Query-defined groups of users, Microsoft 365 groups or sites that Microsoft Purview policies target; administrators care because scope membership decides who a policy reaches.

admin-center.label: Admin centre
admin-center.description: Settings that live in one of Microsoft's admin portals rather than in the product itself.

admin-controls.label: Admin controls
admin-controls.description: Settings an administrator can use to turn a feature on or off, or to limit it.

adoption.label: Adoption
adoption.description: Helping people use a feature well: guidance, training and champions.

agent-365.label: Microsoft Agent 365
agent-365.description: Microsoft's per-user service for registering, governing and securing every agent in the tenant, built on the Microsoft 365 admin centre, Entra, Purview and Defender.

agent-and-plugin-access.label: Agent and plug-in access
agent-and-plugin-access.description: The Microsoft 365 admin centre setting that controls which agents and plug-ins users may use in Copilot.

agent-evaluation.label: Agent evaluation
agent-evaluation.description: Testing an agent's answers against expected results before and after release.

agent-flows.label: Agent flows
agent-flows.description: Copilot Studio's step-by-step automations that an agent can run, the successor to Power Automate flows inside agents.

agent-framework.label: Microsoft Agent Framework
agent-framework.description: Microsoft's SDK for building AI agents in code; administrators care because custom agents built with it sit outside Copilot Studio's admin controls.

agent-governance.label: Agent governance
agent-governance.description: The policies and controls over which agents exist, who owns them and what they may do.

agent-identity.label: Agent identity
agent-identity.description: Whose permissions an agent uses when it acts: a user's, a maker's, or an identity of its own in Microsoft Entra.

agent-registry.label: Agent registry
agent-registry.description: The tenant-wide inventory of agents in the Microsoft 365 admin centre and Entra, used to find, block and manage them.

agent-users.label: Agent users
agent-users.description: Dataverse user records that represent an agent, so it can be given security roles like a person.

agents.label: Agents
agents.description: AI agents: Copilot or Copilot Studio builds that answer questions and take actions on a user's or the organisation's behalf, each with its own identity and controls.

ai.label: AI
ai.description: A feature that uses an AI model to generate or interpret content.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Usage and performance reporting for a site, app or agent.

app-designer.label: App designer
app-designer.description: The Power Apps maker tool for assembling a model-driven app from tables, forms and views.

app-management.label: App and agent management
app-management.description: Controls for which Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 apps and agents are allowed, blocked and installed, and for whom; admins use them to govern app sprawl.

application-insights.label: Application Insights
application-insights.description: Azure Monitor's telemetry service. Sending logs there creates Azure spend and a new place where usage data is stored.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.description: A person signing off a step before it proceeds.

auditing.label: Auditing
auditing.description: Whether an action is recorded in the audit log, by whom, and whether the record attributes it to a person or an agent.

authentication.label: Authentication
authentication.description: How users, visitors and agents prove who they are before they are let in.

authorisation.label: Authorisation
authorisation.description: What a signed-in user, visitor or agent is allowed to do once identified.

auto-labeling.label: Auto-labeling
auto-labeling.description: Policies that apply sensitivity labels to files and email automatically; administrators care because they change content at scale.

automation.label: Automation
automation.description: A task carried out by rules or an agent rather than by a person each time.

autonomous-agents.label: Autonomous agents
autonomous-agents.description: Agents that start from a trigger or schedule and act without a person in the conversation. Higher risk, so they need approval steps and clear ownership.

azure-firewall.label: Azure Firewall
azure-firewall.description: Azure's managed network firewall. Administrators care because network rules and security profiles there decide which traffic other services inspect.

backup-and-recovery.label: Backup and recovery
backup-and-recovery.description: Microsoft 365 Backup and other services for restoring data after deletion, corruption or ransomware. Usually billed by consumption.

business-central.label: Dynamics 365 Business Central
business-central.description: Microsoft's cloud ERP for small and mid-sized businesses; administrators manage its Copilot and agent capabilities per environment.

business-skills.label: Business skills
business-skills.description: Natural-language process instructions stored in Dataverse that agents discover through Work IQ and follow when carrying out a task.

call-queues.label: Teams call queues
call-queues.description: Teams Phone call queues that route inbound calls to representatives; administrators configure their recording, history and announcements.

canvas-apps.label: Canvas apps
canvas-apps.description: Power Apps apps that makers lay out screen by screen in Power Apps Studio; administrators govern them through environments and data policies.

capacity-packs.label: Capacity packs
capacity-packs.description: Prepaid bundles of Copilot Credits or messages bought in advance instead of billed by use, and allocated to environments.

case-management-agent.label: Case Management Agent
case-management-agent.description: The Dynamics 365 Customer Service agent that creates, resolves, follows up and closes cases, and that powers email resolution.

channels.label: Channels
channels.description: The surfaces an agent is published to, such as Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, a website or a custom app.

classifiers.label: Classifiers
classifiers.description: Microsoft Purview rules that identify sensitive content, such as sensitive information types and trainable classifiers; policies and labels depend on them.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.description: Anthropic's command-line coding agent, which Microsoft now supports as a client for some Power Platform developer tools.

client-api.label: Client API
client-api.description: Browser-side JavaScript interfaces for controlling site components and data; administrators care because the code runs under the visitor's session and permissions.

clipchamp.label: Microsoft Clipchamp
clipchamp.description: Microsoft's video creation and video hub experience in Microsoft 365; administrators care because its Copilot features can draw on work content and use Copilot Credits.

cloud-policy.label: Cloud Policy
cloud-policy.description: The Microsoft 365 Apps policy service (config.office.com), used to push settings to Office and Copilot clients.

code-apps.label: Power Apps code apps
code-apps.description: Custom web apps written in a code-first IDE that run on Power Platform; admins enable them per environment and govern them with existing platform policies.

coding-agents.label: Coding agents
coding-agents.description: AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code that write and change code, here pointed at Power Platform solutions.

command-line-tools.label: Command-line tools
command-line-tools.description: Tools run from a terminal or script; administrators care because they can automate changes at scale and need their own access and audit controls.

communication-compliance.label: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance
communication-compliance.description: Purview solution that inspects messages for policy violations and raises alerts for reviewers; administrators own its policies, role groups and alert settings.

computer-use.label: Computer use
computer-use.description: An agent that operates a browser or desktop as a person would, clicking and typing. Powerful and hard to constrain, so it needs tight scoping.

conditional-access.label: Conditional Access
conditional-access.description: Microsoft Entra policies that decide whether a sign-in is allowed, based on conditions such as device state, location or multifactor authentication.

connection-references.label: Connection references
connection-references.description: Solution components that point an app or flow at a connection, so the credentials behind it can be swapped per environment.

connectors.label: Connectors
connectors.description: Power Platform connectors: the prebuilt links from apps, flows and agents to services such as SharePoint, SQL or Salesforce. Governed with data policies.

contact-center.label: Dynamics 365 Contact Center
contact-center.description: Microsoft's contact centre product for voice and messaging customer service. Administrators configure its routing and queues.

control-plane.label: Control plane
control-plane.description: A single place from which every agent in the tenant can be found, governed and secured.

conversation-orchestration.label: Conversation orchestration
conversation-orchestration.description: Natural language playbooks that change priority, overflow and assignment for queued conversations, and use Copilot credits when published.

copilot.label: Microsoft Copilot
copilot.description: Microsoft Copilot in general: changes that span the Copilot experiences rather than one product.

copilot-chat.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
copilot-chat.description: The web-grounded Copilot chat available to all Microsoft 365 users, with paid models and agents metered through Copilot Credits.

copilot-code.label: Copilot Code
copilot-code.description: The Code tab in Microsoft Copilot, which builds software from plain-language descriptions. Administrators govern it through spending policies and Copilot Code policy settings.

copilot-connectors.label: Copilot connectors
copilot-connectors.description: Formerly Graph connectors: they index external content so that Microsoft 365 Copilot can search and act on it.

copilot-control-system.label: Copilot Control System
copilot-control-system.description: Microsoft's name for the set of admin centre controls, reports and policies for governing Copilot and agents across the tenant.

copilot-credits.label: Copilot Credits
copilot-credits.description: The shared meter that pays for agents, Copilot Chat models and Copilot Studio usage. Bought prepaid in packs or billed pay-as-you-go through Azure.

copilot-harness.label: Microsoft Copilot harness
copilot-harness.description: The runtime that executes an agent's tools and actions on Microsoft's side, including web browsing and computer use. Agents on it bill Copilot Credits.

copilot-in-power-automate.label: Copilot in Power Automate
copilot-in-power-automate.description: AI assistance inside the Power Automate designers for building and repairing flows.

copilot-managed-runtime.label: Copilot Managed Runtime
copilot-managed-runtime.description: The managed host where apps built in Copilot Code, Cowork or Copilot Studio are published and run. Administrators govern those apps from the Microsoft 365 admin center.

copilot-notebooks.label: Copilot Notebooks
copilot-notebooks.description: Notebooks that ground Microsoft 365 Copilot on a user's own notes and files; their creation is governed by Cloud Policy and their content is stored in the tenant.

copilot-pages.label: Copilot Pages
copilot-pages.description: Shareable, editable pages created from Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Administrators govern them through Cloud Policy, Purview and storage settings.

copilot-search.label: Copilot Search
copilot-search.description: The search experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, which admins tune through the Microsoft 365 admin center with bookmarks, acronyms and trusted sources.

copilot-studio.label: Copilot Studio
copilot-studio.description: Microsoft's low-code tool for building and publishing agents, paid for by message or by Copilot Credits.

cost-management.label: Cost management
cost-management.description: Reports, budgets and policies for seeing and capping what Copilot and agents spend.

cowork.label: Copilot Cowork
cowork.description: Copilot's agentic work mode, where it carries out multi-step tasks across apps and the web on the user's behalf. Governed and metered alongside Copilot Chat.

credit-requests.label: Credit requests
credit-requests.description: Users asking for Copilot Credits or paid models to be enabled for them, routed to administrators for approval.

cross-tenant.label: Cross-tenant
cross-tenant.description: Moving or sharing data between two Microsoft 365 tenants, for example after a merger or divestiture.

custom-api.label: Custom APIs
custom-api.description: Developer-defined Dataverse operations with their own logic and permissions, now callable from generative pages and agents.

custom-engine-agents.label: Custom engine agents
custom-engine-agents.description: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot that bring their own orchestrator and models, hosted outside Microsoft 365, so the builder owns their security and compliance.

customer-insights.label: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights
customer-insights.description: Microsoft's customer data platform and journey tools; its unified profiles hold personal data that agents can now read.

customer-key.label: Customer Key (customer-managed encryption keys)
customer-key.description: Microsoft Purview Customer Key lets an organisation hold the root keys that encrypt its Microsoft 365 data at rest, so administrators care about key custody and revocation.

customer-service.label: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
customer-service.description: Dynamics 365 application for case management and customer support; administrators care because its agents and settings sit outside Microsoft 365 admin centre.

data-export.label: Data export
data-export.description: Copying telemetry or records out of the service to a store you control, such as Azure.

data-governance.label: Data governance
data-governance.description: Defining what data means, who owns it and how it may be used, so that agents reason about it correctly.

data-lifecycle-management.label: Data lifecycle management
data-lifecycle-management.description: Purview's retention and deletion policies across Microsoft 365 workloads.

data-policies.label: Data policies (Power Platform DLP)
data-policies.description: Power Platform's connector classification policies, which decide which connectors may be used together in an environment.

data-residency.label: Data residency
data-residency.description: Which geography data is stored and processed in, and whether an AI feature keeps it in your region.

dataverse.label: Dataverse
dataverse.description: The Power Platform's data service, where model-driven apps, Copilot Studio agents and Dynamics 365 store and secure their data.

dataverse-mcp.label: Dataverse MCP server
dataverse-mcp.description: An MCP server that exposes Dataverse tables and operations to agents and coding tools.

debugging.label: Debugging
debugging.description: Finding and fixing faults in flows, apps or agents.

declarative-agents.label: Declarative agents
declarative-agents.description: Agents defined by instructions, knowledge and actions rather than code, built in Copilot Studio or the agent builder.

defender-for-cloud-apps.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
defender-for-cloud-apps.description: Microsoft's cloud app security service. Its app connectors link third-party SaaS apps to Microsoft security and compliance tools, so administrators manage them alongside Purview policies.

defender-for-office-365.label: Microsoft Defender for Office 365
defender-for-office-365.description: Microsoft's email and collaboration security service. Administrators need it, or Defender XDR, to review user-reported items from Teams in the Defender portal.

defender-xdr.label: Microsoft Defender XDR
defender-xdr.description: Microsoft's extended detection and response portal where security analysts triage alerts and incidents; administrators care because analysts act on Purview alerts there.

delegation.label: Delegation
delegation.description: Letting a named non-admin role carry out a task that previously needed a global or service administrator.

demand-planning.label: Demand planning
demand-planning.description: The Supply Chain Management app that forecasts demand from sales history; its licences, roles and AI features are set up separately from the core app.

design-studio.label: Power Pages design studio
design-studio.description: The maker tool for building and configuring a Power Pages site.

desktop-flows.label: Desktop flows
desktop-flows.description: Power Automate's robotic process automation: flows that drive desktop applications through their user interface.

device-onboarding.label: Device onboarding
device-onboarding.description: Enrolling Windows and macOS devices so Endpoint DLP and insider risk management can monitor them; administrators check each device's configuration and policy sync status here.

dlp.label: DLP (data loss prevention)
dlp.description: Policies that stop sensitive data leaving where it should stay: Purview DLP for Microsoft 365, and data policies for Power Platform connectors.

document-generation.label: Document generation
document-generation.description: Features that produce documents from templates or prompts; administrators care about where the output is stored and which permissions and labels apply to it.

dod.label: US Government: DoD
dod.description: The Microsoft 365 cloud for the US Department of Defense, the most restricted US Government instance. Features usually arrive here last, often a year or more after Worldwide.

domain-exclusion.label: Domain exclusion
domain-exclusion.description: Blocking named websites from Copilot's web grounding, so answers never draw on them.

dspm.label: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
dspm.description: The Microsoft Purview solution that shows where sensitive data sits, who can reach it and how well it is protected; administrators use it to prioritise data security work.

dynamics-365.label: Dynamics 365
dynamics-365.description: Microsoft's business applications on Dataverse: Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Finance and others.

e7.label: Microsoft 365 E7
e7.description: The Microsoft 365 suite above E5 that bundles Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agent 365 and the advanced security and compliance features.

edge-for-business.label: Microsoft Edge for Business
edge-for-business.description: The managed work browser from Microsoft. Administrators care because its policies and connectors decide what users can paste, upload, download or print.

ediscovery.label: eDiscovery
ediscovery.description: Purview's search and hold tooling for legal and compliance investigations. New content types matter only if eDiscovery can see them.

education.label: Education
education.description: Features for schools and universities, such as the Teams for Education Policy Wizard, where policies differ for students and educators.

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.description: Content protected with a sensitivity label or rights management, and whether an agent can read it.

end-user-authentication.label: End-user authentication
end-user-authentication.description: The agent asks each user to sign in and acts with that user's permissions, rather than with credentials the maker supplied.

endpoint-dlp.label: Endpoint DLP
endpoint-dlp.description: Data loss prevention policies enforced on onboarded Windows and macOS devices; administrators care because a device that has not received the latest policy does not enforce it.

endpoint-filtering.label: Endpoint filtering
endpoint-filtering.description: A data-policy rule that limits a connector to named hosts or URLs, for example only your own MCP servers.

enterprise-data-protection.label: Enterprise data protection
enterprise-data-protection.description: Microsoft's contractual and technical protections for prompts and responses in Copilot used with a work account; admins cite it when approving Copilot features.

entra-agent-id.label: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
entra-agent-id.description: An identity in Microsoft Entra created for an agent, so it can be given its own permissions, conditional access and audit trail.

entra-id.label: Microsoft Entra ID
entra-id.description: Microsoft's identity service, formerly Azure Active Directory, where users, groups, apps and now agents are registered.

environment-groups.label: Environment groups
environment-groups.description: Sets of Power Platform environments that share one bundle of rules, so governance is applied once rather than per environment.

excel.label: Microsoft Excel
excel.description: Microsoft Excel, including Copilot in Excel. Administrators follow it because workbooks hold finance data that Copilot can read and change.

extensibility.label: Extensibility
extensibility.description: Ways to add tools, knowledge or actions to an agent beyond what ships in the box.

external-meeting-bots.label: External meeting bots
external-meeting-bots.description: Third-party note-taking and transcription bots that join Teams meetings; administrators care because they can capture meeting content outside the organisation's compliance boundary.

extract-usage-right.label: Extract usage right
extract-usage-right.description: The sensitivity-label permission that allows content to be copied out of a protected file, which Copilot needs before it can summarise it.

facilitator.label: Facilitator
facilitator.description: The Copilot agent in Teams meetings that takes notes and keeps the shared record.

federated-connectors.label: Federated connectors
federated-connectors.description: Connectors that query an external system live at the moment of the request, instead of indexing a copy of its data into Microsoft 365.

field-service.label: Dynamics 365 Field Service
field-service.description: The Dynamics 365 application for scheduling and dispatching technicians; administrators care because its Copilot and agent features carry their own roles and billing.

file-upload.label: File upload
file-upload.description: Users attaching files to an agent conversation, which the agent then reads.

filter-based-security.label: Filter-based security
filter-based-security.description: Dataverse access rules written as column-value filters, so a security role sees only the rows that match.

finance-and-operations.label: Finance and operations apps
finance-and-operations.description: The Dynamics 365 ERP apps (Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations, Commerce) that run on the finance and operations platform.

finops.label: FinOps
finops.description: The practice of forecasting, monitoring and controlling cloud spend; here, Copilot and agent consumption.

form-fill-assistance.label: Form fill assistance
form-fill-assistance.description: Copilot in model-driven apps suggesting field values from context, files or speech.

frontier-models.label: Frontier models
frontier-models.description: The newest, most capable AI models offered inside Copilot, usually metered separately through Copilot Credits.

frontier-program.label: Microsoft Frontier program
frontier-program.description: Microsoft's opt-in programme for pre-release AI features; admins control which users and groups can reach them.

gcc.label: US Government: GCC
gcc.description: Government Community Cloud, the US public-sector cloud for federal, state and local bodies with moderate data-handling requirements. Features arrive after Worldwide.

gcc-high.label: US Government: GCC High
gcc-high.description: The US Government cloud for controlled unclassified information and defence contractors, run in isolated Azure Government data centres. Features arrive later than GCC.

generative-pages.label: Generative pages
generative-pages.description: Power Apps pages generated from a natural-language description, with AI producing the layout and logic.

github.label: GitHub
github.description: Microsoft's code hosting platform, also the source of the GitHub Models catalogue used by some Power Platform AI features.

github-copilot-cli.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
github-copilot-cli.description: GitHub's command-line coding agent, supported as a client for some Power Platform developer tools.

global-secure-access.label: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
global-secure-access.description: Microsoft Entra's network access service, including Internet Access, which routes and inspects user traffic; administrators govern it with security profiles and Conditional Access.

glossary.label: Business glossary
glossary.description: Definitions of business terms attached to data, so that Copilot and agents interpret it consistently.

governance.label: Governance
governance.description: Policies, roles and settings that decide who may build, publish and run things, and what they may reach.

graders.label: Graders
graders.description: Automated judges, often AI models, that score an agent's answers during evaluation.

guardrails.label: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Limits placed on what an agent may do without a person approving, such as confirmation before an action runs.

guest-access.label: Guest access
guest-access.description: How external people are invited into your tenant as guests, and the risks and controls around those invitations.

hris-import.label: HRIS data import
hris-import.description: Bringing employee records from a human resources information system into Microsoft 365 apps; administrators care because it moves personal data between systems.

human-in-the-loop.label: Human in the loop
human-in-the-loop.description: A person approves or reviews an agent's action before it takes effect.

identity.label: Identity
identity.description: The accounts, groups and sign-in rules that decide who someone is in Microsoft 365.

identity-providers.label: Identity providers
identity-providers.description: The external sign-in services a Power Pages site trusts, such as Entra ID, Entra External ID or a social provider.

impersonation.label: Impersonation
impersonation.description: One identity acting as another, for example a site visitor mapped to a Dataverse user so that its security roles apply.

inactive-agents.label: Inactive agents
inactive-agents.description: Agents nobody has used for a set period, which lifecycle rules can block or delete.

information-protection.label: Information protection
information-protection.description: Sensitivity labels, encryption and rights management that travel with content.

insider-risk-management.label: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
insider-risk-management.description: Purview solution that correlates signals to find malicious or inadvertent insider risks; administrators care because its policies decide what is detected and who can see it.

integration.label: Integration
integration.description: Connecting a service to other systems through APIs and connectors.

intelligent-recap.label: Intelligent recap
intelligent-recap.description: The AI meeting summary in Teams: notes, tasks and chapters generated from the transcript.

inventory.label: Microsoft 365 Apps Inventory
inventory.description: The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center report of devices, Office builds, channels and add-ins; features such as Update Repair read their data from it.

island-enterprise-browser.label: Island Enterprise Browser
island-enterprise-browser.description: A non-Microsoft enterprise browser that integrates with Microsoft Purview so administrators can apply Purview policies to browser activity.

just-in-time-protection.label: Just-in-time protection
just-in-time-protection.description: Endpoint DLP feature that audits or blocks egress activity on files not yet evaluated by DLP policy; administrators set its scope and fallback action.

knowledge-grounding.label: Knowledge grounding
knowledge-grounding.description: The data sources an agent is pointed at, so its answers come from your content rather than the model's training.

last-accessed.label: Last accessed date
last-accessed.description: The date content was last opened, now usable as the trigger for retention rather than when it was created or modified.

learning-agent.label: Learning agent
learning-agent.description: Microsoft's AI learning assistant for Microsoft 365. Administrators deploy it and decide who gets personalised learning suggestions and nudges.

least-privilege.label: Least privilege
least-privilege.description: Giving an agent, user or app only the permissions its task needs, and nothing more.

licensing.label: Licensing
licensing.description: Which subscriptions and add-ons a feature needs, and how usage is counted.

lifecycle.label: Lifecycle management
lifecycle.description: Rules for what happens to agents and apps over time: review, block, hand over or delete.

lifecycle-services.label: Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services
lifecycle-services.description: The portal that has managed finance and operations environments and projects; administrators track what moves to Power Platform admin center.

m365-admin-center.label: Microsoft 365 admin centre
m365-admin-center.description: The tenant admin portal (admin.microsoft.com), now home to Copilot and agent settings, billing and usage reports.

m365-archive.label: Microsoft 365 Archive
m365-archive.description: The cold storage tier for inactive SharePoint sites and files, billed per GB; administrators care because it changes storage cost, Copilot indexing and how users reach content.

m365-backup.label: Microsoft 365 Backup
m365-backup.description: Microsoft's consumption-billed backup service for SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange and now Teams and Entra.

m365-copilot.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot
m365-copilot.description: The per-user Copilot licence that grounds Copilot in a user's Microsoft 365 data: email, files, meetings and chats.

macos.label: macOS
macos.description: Apple's Mac operating system. Administrators care because Mac clients often sit outside Windows-centred deployment and policy tooling.

maker-credentials.label: Maker credentials
maker-credentials.description: Connections an agent makes with the credentials of the person who built it. Every user then acts with the maker's access, which is why administrators can block it.

maker-guidelines.label: Maker guidelines
maker-guidelines.description: Your organisation's own rules for builders, shown inside Power Platform tools in Managed Environments.

maker-studio.label: Power Apps maker studio
maker-studio.description: The browser-based design surface where Power Apps are built (make.powerapps.com).

managed-environments.label: Managed Environments
managed-environments.description: The premium Power Platform governance tier: sharing limits, usage insights, data policies and maker guidance for the environments you enrol. Needs premium licences.

mcp.label: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
mcp.description: An open standard that lets agents call external tools and data sources. Each MCP connection is a new path for data out and actions in, so it falls under connector and data-policy controls.

mcp-server.label: MCP server
mcp-server.description: A service that exposes tools and data to agents over the Model Context Protocol.

meeting-memory.label: Meeting memory
meeting-memory.description: AI-generated knowledge retained from meetings across sessions, so later meetings and agents can draw on it.

meeting-policy.label: Teams meeting policy
meeting-policy.description: The Teams admin centre policy that turns meeting features such as transcription and recap on or off for groups of users.

meeting-templates.label: Teams meeting templates
meeting-templates.description: Admin-defined sets of Teams meeting options that can be locked, hidden or defaulted, which administrators use to apply meeting settings at scale.

meeting-transcripts.label: Meeting transcripts
meeting-transcripts.description: The written record of a Teams meeting: a sensitive data source for recaps, agents and eDiscovery.

memory.label: Agent memory
memory.description: What an agent remembers about a user or past sessions, and the controls over it.

microsoft-365-apps.label: Microsoft 365 Apps
microsoft-365-apps.description: The desktop Office apps (Word, Excel, Outlook and others) installed through Click-to-Run, which admins update and monitor from the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

microsoft-365-files.label: Microsoft 365 files
microsoft-365-files.description: Word, Excel and PDF files in OneDrive and SharePoint used as a source by a Power Platform feature.

microsoft-edge.label: Microsoft Edge
microsoft-edge.description: The Microsoft Edge browser and its management policies; admins care because browser policy decides which Copilot features users can reach.

microsoft-fabric.label: Microsoft Fabric
microsoft-fabric.description: Microsoft's analytics platform (OneLake, Lakehouses, semantic models). Administrators care because data exported to it is then governed in Fabric workspaces.

microsoft-forms.label: Microsoft Forms
microsoft-forms.description: Microsoft's form and survey product, which also provides the form experience inside SharePoint document libraries; administrators care about who can create and share forms.

microsoft-graph.label: Microsoft Graph
microsoft-graph.description: The API behind Microsoft 365, used by connectors, agents and administrators’ scripts.

microsoft-iq.label: Microsoft IQ
microsoft-iq.description: Microsoft's name for the shared intelligence layer that gives agents organisational context. Administrators meet it through Work IQ and its sibling capabilities.

microsoft-loop.label: Microsoft Loop
microsoft-loop.description: Microsoft's collaborative workspace app, whose personal and shared content lives in SharePoint Embedded containers that compliance tools must target.

microsoft-to-do.label: Microsoft To Do
microsoft-to-do.description: Microsoft's personal task app. Administrators care because its task store has had its own eDiscovery, retention and Power Automate behaviour.

migration.label: Migration
migration.description: Moving data, users or workloads from one place to another.

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.description: Features in the iOS and Android apps.

model-driven-apps.label: Model-driven apps
model-driven-apps.description: Power Apps built on Dataverse tables and forms rather than a hand-drawn canvas. Most Dynamics 365 apps are model-driven.

model-selector.label: Model selector
model-selector.description: The drop-down in Copilot Chat where users choose which AI model answers, including paid frontier models.

modern-controls.label: Modern controls
modern-controls.description: The Fluent-based control set for canvas apps that makers turn on per app; it affects how apps look and which controls makers can add.

monitor-hub.label: Monitor hub
monitor-hub.description: The Power Platform admin centre's area for operational monitoring of apps, sites and flows.

monitoring.label: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Watching the health, usage and errors of an app, site or agent in operation.

multi-line-calling.label: Multi-line calling
multi-line-calling.description: Lets an administrator assign several phone numbers to one Teams Phone user; changes to it affect how those users call and are called.

network-data-security.label: Purview network data security
network-data-security.description: Purview collection and DLP policies that inspect network traffic sent to unmanaged cloud and AI apps through an integrated SASE or secure browser solution.

object-centric.label: Object-centric process mining
object-centric.description: Process mining that follows several related objects, such as orders and invoices, instead of a single case ID.

on-premises-data-gateway.label: On-premises data gateway
on-premises-data-gateway.description: The bridge that lets cloud services reach databases and files inside your own network.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.description: Features that help new users, members or devices get started, so administrators know what to communicate and where to check.

onedrive.label: OneDrive
onedrive.description: Personal file storage in Microsoft 365, and a common source for Copilot and agents.

onenote.label: OneNote
onenote.description: Microsoft's note-taking app, which hosts Copilot Notebooks; administrators track its Copilot features and the policies that govern them.

organisation-prompts.label: Organisation prompts
organisation-prompts.description: Prompts published by your organisation for everyone in Copilot, through Prompt Lab or the Copilot Prompt Gallery.

organizational-data-service.label: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service
organizational-data-service.description: The central service in the Microsoft 365 admin center that imports employee data and decides which Microsoft 365 and Viva apps can read each attribute.

organizational-messages.label: Organizational messages
organizational-messages.description: Admin-authored in-product messages sent to users on Windows, Teams and email; administrators govern who may author them and who receives them.

outlook.label: Outlook
outlook.description: Microsoft Outlook on Windows, the web and other platforms; administrators care because mail, calendar and folder-sharing settings are governed per client.

outreach-email.label: Outreach email
outreach-email.description: Emails that sales agents draft and send to prospects; administrators care because wording, compliance and consumption are set centrally.

oversharing.label: Oversharing
oversharing.description: Content or credentials shared more widely than intended, which Copilot and agents then surface to people who should not see it.

ownerless-agents.label: Ownerless agents
ownerless-agents.description: Agents whose maker has left or been removed, leaving nobody accountable for them.

p3.label: Copilot Credit Pre-purchase Plan (P3)
p3.description: A one-year commitment to Copilot Credits bought at a discount through Azure, with overage billed pay-as-you-go.

palo-alto-prisma-access.label: Palo Alto Prisma Access
palo-alto-prisma-access.description: Palo Alto Networks' secure access service edge (SASE) product, which Purview integrates with so network traffic can be classified and protected by Purview policies.

password-manager.label: Password manager
password-manager.description: The browser feature that saves and fills sign-in credentials; administrators govern it through browser policies because it holds credentials users can reuse.

pay-as-you-go.label: Pay-as-you-go
pay-as-you-go.description: Usage billed to an Azure subscription after the event instead of a prepaid licence. Spend is uncapped unless a spending policy or budget is set.

performance.label: Performance
performance.description: How quickly and reliably a site, app or agent responds.

personal-settings.label: Personal settings
personal-settings.description: The per-user preferences page in model-driven apps.

personalisation.label: Personalisation
personalisation.description: Features that adapt to an individual user by remembering their preferences and history.

planner.label: Microsoft Planner
planner.description: Microsoft's task and project management app, including its basic and premium plans and the Planner Agent. Administrators control access to its Copilot features through Planner settings.

plug-ins.label: Dataverse plug-ins
plug-ins.description: Custom code that runs inside Dataverse when records change or a custom API is called.

plugins.label: Plugins (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
plugins.description: Installable packages of skills, tools and agents that extend Microsoft Copilot experiences; admins govern them in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

point-in-time-restore.label: Point-in-time restore
point-in-time-restore.description: Rolling data back to how it was at a chosen moment.

policy.label: Policy
policy.description: A rule set by an administrator that applies to many users, agents or environments at once.

power-apps.label: Power Apps
power-apps.description: The Power Platform's app builder, covering canvas apps, model-driven apps and generative pages.

power-apps-cli.label: Power Apps CLI (pa)
power-apps-cli.description: The npm-based command line tool (pa) for building, connecting and publishing code apps; separate from the pac Power Platform CLI.

power-automate.label: Power Automate
power-automate.description: The Power Platform's workflow and automation service, including desktop flows and process mining.

power-bi.label: Power BI
power-bi.description: Microsoft's reporting and dashboard service. Administrators care because reports built on shared data models need their own licences and workspace access.

power-pages.label: Power Pages
power-pages.description: The Power Platform's service for external-facing websites backed by Dataverse, with its own authentication, web roles and table permissions.

power-platform.label: Power Platform
power-platform.description: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Copilot Studio and Dataverse together, and the administration that spans them.

power-platform-admin-center.label: Power Platform admin centre
power-platform-admin-center.description: The admin portal for Power Platform environments, policies, capacity, billing and Copilot Studio settings (admin.powerplatform.microsoft.com).

power-platform-cli.label: Power Platform CLI
power-platform-cli.description: The pac command-line tool for developers and administrators, now with MCP and coding-agent support.

powerpoint.label: Microsoft PowerPoint
powerpoint.description: Microsoft's presentation app on desktop and web; administrators track Copilot and add-in changes there because users author shared decks in it.

powershell.label: PowerShell
powershell.description: Admin settings that are managed, or only available, through PowerShell cmdlets.

priority-cleanup.label: Priority cleanup
priority-cleanup.description: A Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management workflow that deletes targeted content despite retention settings and holds, after approval. Administrators need to govern who can use it.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: What personal data a feature collects, who can see it, and how users are told.

pro-management-portal.label: Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
pro-management-portal.description: Microsoft's cloud portal for inventory, health monitoring, updates and settings of Teams devices, which administrators use alongside or instead of the Teams admin center.

process-intelligence.label: Process Intelligence Studio
process-intelligence.description: Power Automate's workspace for analysing how business processes actually run.

process-mining.label: Process mining
process-mining.description: Reconstructing how a process runs from system event logs, to find delays and deviations.

prompt-columns.label: Prompt columns
prompt-columns.description: A Dataverse column type that stores AI-generated results from a prompt; administrators care because each run consumes credits and the output is kept in table data.

prompt-lab.label: Prompt Lab
prompt-lab.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot tool for writing, testing and publishing shared prompts.

publish-controls.label: Publish controls
publish-controls.description: Checks applied when a maker publishes or shares an agent, such as blocking it until a risk is fixed.

purview.label: Microsoft Purview
purview.description: Microsoft's compliance suite: DLP, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery and audit.

quality-assurance.label: Quality assurance
quality-assurance.description: Testing and evaluating agents before and after release.

queues-app.label: Teams Queues app
queues-app.description: The Teams app where call queue representatives and supervisors see queue calls and metrics; administrators care because it needs a Teams Premium licence.

ransomware.label: Ransomware
ransomware.description: Malicious encryption or deletion of data, and the recovery options that limit the damage.

real-time.label: Real time
real-time.description: Data delivered as it is produced rather than after the event.

recipes.label: Recipes (Work IQ)
recipes.description: Reusable, multi-step task definitions that coordinate tools and actions, which Work IQ agents can run.

release-channels.label: Release channels
release-channels.description: The monthly and semi-annual channels that decide when model-driven app features reach an environment, which administrators use to pace user-facing change.

resilience.label: Resilience
resilience.description: The ability to recover a service or its data after failure, deletion or attack.

restore.label: Restore
restore.description: Bringing deleted or damaged data back from a backup.

retention.label: Retention
retention.description: Purview rules for how long content is kept and when it is deleted, including AI-generated content such as transcripts and recaps.

row-level-security.label: Row-level security
row-level-security.description: Access rules that decide which individual records a user or agent can see.

row-summary.label: Row summaries
row-summary.description: Copilot's one-paragraph summary of a record in a model-driven app form.

run-only.label: Run-only sharing
run-only.description: Sharing an agent or flow so that others can use it but not open or edit it.

sales-agent.label: Sales agent
sales-agent.description: Microsoft's AI assistant for sellers that works across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook and Teams and connects to Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce.

sales-development-agent.label: Sales Development agent
sales-development-agent.description: An agent that runs email outreach to sales prospects and hands interested ones to sellers; admins care because it contacts external people on its own.

sales-qualification-agent.label: Sales Qualification Agent
sales-qualification-agent.description: The Dynamics 365 Sales agent that researches leads and drafts outreach emails; administrators configure it and pay for its consumption.

security-agent.label: Security agent
security-agent.description: An AI agent that proposes or applies security configuration, here in the Power Pages design studio.

security-copilot.label: Microsoft Security Copilot
security-copilot.description: Microsoft's AI platform for security and compliance work. It runs on Security Compute Units, so administrators care about capacity and cost.

security-roles.label: Security roles
security-roles.description: Dataverse's permission sets, assigned to users, teams and now agents, that decide which tables and rows they can read or change.

selectors.label: UI selectors
selectors.description: The rules a desktop flow uses to find buttons and fields on screen. They break when an application’s interface changes.

semantic-model.label: Semantic model
semantic-model.description: Business meaning layered on tables and columns, so that AI understands relationships and terms.

sensitive-information-types.label: Sensitive information types
sensitive-information-types.description: Purview's detectors for data such as card numbers and national IDs, used by DLP policies.

sensitivity-labels.label: Sensitivity labels
sensitivity-labels.description: Purview labels that classify and protect content, sometimes with encryption that decides whether Copilot can read it.

server-logging.label: Server logging
server-logging.description: Server-side error and access logs for a website: useful for support, and a new store of visitor data.

server-logic.label: Server-side logic
server-logic.description: Code that runs on the server rather than in the visitor's browser, for example to call a connector securely.

service-principal.label: Service principal
service-principal.description: An application identity in Entra ID that a service or agent uses to act without a signed-in user.

service-principals.label: Service principals
service-principals.description: Non-human identities, such as Microsoft Entra app registrations, that own or run resources; administrators care because they sit outside user lifecycle and licensing.

shared-call-history.label: Shared call history
shared-call-history.description: A call queue history of missed calls, voicemails and call status that a template shares with representatives and supervisors; administrators control who sees it.

sharepoint.label: SharePoint
sharepoint.description: Microsoft 365 sites and document libraries, the largest source of content for Copilot and agents.

sharepoint-advanced-management.label: SharePoint Advanced Management
sharepoint-advanced-management.description: Microsoft's set of SharePoint governance features, including Data access governance reports; administrators need to know which licence unlocks them.

sharepoint-agents.label: SharePoint agents
sharepoint-agents.description: Agents created from a SharePoint site or library and grounded on its content.

sharepoint-embedded.label: SharePoint Embedded
sharepoint-embedded.description: Headless SharePoint storage for applications, which some Copilot features use to hold generated content.

sharing.label: Sharing
sharing.description: Who an agent, app or flow is shared with, and the limits an administrator can place on that.

sharing-limits.label: Sharing limits
sharing-limits.description: Managed Environments rules that cap how widely makers can share apps and agents.

skills.label: Agent skills
skills.description: Reusable packages of instructions that an agent applies to matching tasks. Administrators care because a shared skill changes agent behaviour in every agent that adds it.

solutions.label: Solutions
solutions.description: The Power Platform's packaging unit for moving apps, flows, agents and tables between environments.

speech.label: Speech input
speech.description: Dictating to a feature instead of typing.

spending-policies.label: Spending policies
spending-policies.description: Administrator-set limits on how many Copilot Credits an agent, app or user may consume before it is stopped.

sql.label: SQL
sql.description: SQL Server and Azure SQL databases, reached from the Power Platform through the SQL connector.

stale-content.label: Stale content
stale-content.description: Old, unused files that Copilot can still find and surface, and that retention can now remove.

supply-chain-management.label: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
supply-chain-management.description: Microsoft's supply chain application for planning, inventory, warehousing and production; relevant when its AI features reach planners.

sync-app.label: OneDrive sync app
sync-app.description: The OneDrive client that syncs files between a device and OneDrive or SharePoint; administrators configure it through policies on each device.

table-permissions.label: Table permissions
table-permissions.description: Power Pages rules that decide which Dataverse tables and rows a website visitor or web role can read or edit.

teams.label: Microsoft Teams
teams.description: Meetings, chat and channels, and the main surface where agents are published to users.

teams-events.label: Teams events
teams-events.description: Webinars, town halls and other Teams events; an administrator cares because they have their own events policy, separate from meeting policies.

teams-phone.label: Teams Phone
teams-phone.description: The Microsoft Teams calling service that gives users phone numbers; administrators assign numbers, licences and policies to it.

teams-premium.label: Teams Premium
teams-premium.description: The Teams add-on licence that unlocks advanced meeting protection and personalisation features, which administrators must assign to the users who need them.

teams-rooms.label: Microsoft Teams Rooms
teams-rooms.description: Dedicated meeting-room devices and the Pro Management portal used to monitor them; relevant to admins who run room fleets and plan hardware.

telemetry.label: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Usage and diagnostic data collected from an app or site, and where it is sent.

tenant-to-tenant.label: Tenant-to-tenant
tenant-to-tenant.description: Moving mailboxes, sites and accounts from one Microsoft 365 tenant to another.

threat-detection.label: Threat detection
threat-detection.description: Automatic spotting of risky patterns, such as credentials shared too widely.

tool-approval.label: Tool approval
tool-approval.description: A person confirms before an agent runs a specific tool or action.

tools.label: Agent tools
tools.description: The actions an agent can call: connectors, flows, APIs, MCP servers and prompts.

tracking-prevention.label: Tracking prevention
tracking-prevention.description: Microsoft Edge's built-in blocking of known web trackers. Administrators care because its level can break sites and can be set by policy.

transcript-api.label: Transcript API
transcript-api.description: Programmatic access to Teams meeting transcripts for apps and agents.

transcripts.label: Transcripts
transcripts.description: Written records of meetings and calls, and whether they are saved.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.description: Events or schedules that start an agent or flow without a person asking.

ui-automation.label: UI automation
ui-automation.description: Automating applications by driving their user interface, as desktop flows do.

unified-routing.label: Unified routing
unified-routing.description: The Dynamics 365 service that routes and assigns incoming conversations to queues and representatives, and a prerequisite for conversation orchestration.

unlicensed-users.label: Unlicensed users
unlicensed-users.description: People who can be referenced or reached by a feature without holding a licence for it.

usage-based-billing.label: Usage-based billing
usage-based-billing.description: Paying per unit of use, metered after the event, rather than a flat licence.

usage-reports.label: Usage reports
usage-reports.description: Admin centre reports showing who used a feature, how much, and what it cost.

user-confirmation.label: User confirmation
user-confirmation.description: Copilot asks the user to approve before it writes or deletes data in an external system.

user-experience.label: User experience
user-experience.description: A change to how a feature looks or behaves for the people using it.

version-history.label: Version history
version-history.description: The stored earlier versions of SharePoint and OneDrive files, and the limits and trim jobs that decide how many are kept and how much storage they use.

views.label: Views
views.description: Saved lists of records in model-driven apps, now with calendar and card layouts.

viva-engage.label: Viva Engage
viva-engage.description: Microsoft's community and conversation app in Microsoft 365; administrators care because feed and community changes reach every user.

viva-feature-access-management.label: Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM)
viva-feature-access-management.description: The policy system in the Microsoft 365 admin center and PowerShell that turns Viva features on or off for the tenant, groups or users.

viva-glint.label: Microsoft Viva Glint
viva-glint.description: Microsoft's employee survey and listening product; administrators care because it holds employee HR attributes and survey data.

viva-insights.label: Microsoft Viva Insights
viva-insights.description: The Viva Insights web app hosts the Copilot Dashboard and Agent Dashboard that report adoption and usage; administrators control who sees which views.

viva-pulse.label: Microsoft Viva Pulse
viva-pulse.description: Microsoft Viva Pulse sends short employee surveys; administrators care because it collects feedback from staff and has its own privacy thresholds and access controls.

voice-and-face-recognition.label: Voice and face recognition
voice-and-face-recognition.description: Teams features that match enrolled voice and face profiles to people in meeting rooms; administrators care because they use biometric data and have their own enrolment controls.

weaponizable-file-protection.label: Weaponizable File Protection
weaponizable-file-protection.description: Teams protection that blocks messages carrying file types commonly used for malware; administrators care because it applies to chats and channels, including external collaboration.

web-api.label: Web API
web-api.description: The REST interface for reading and writing Dataverse or Power Pages data.

web-browsing.label: Web browsing (agents)
web-browsing.description: An agent visiting live websites to read or act, with the data exposure that implies.

web-grounding.label: Web grounding
web-grounding.description: Copilot sending a query to Bing to improve an answer. Administrators can turn it off or exclude domains.

web-roles.label: Web roles
web-roles.description: Power Pages' permission groups for site visitors, which decide what each visitor can see and do.

web-search.label: Web search
web-search.description: Copilot or an agent searching the public web as part of answering.

windows-photos.label: Photos app for Windows
windows-photos.description: The Photos app on Windows 11, which can show local and OneDrive photos; administrators care because existing app and OneDrive policies decide how it behaves.

word.label: Microsoft Word
word.description: The Microsoft Word app; tagged on changes that affect how Word documents are created, shared or governed.

work-iq.label: Work IQ
work-iq.description: Microsoft's layer of work data, memory and skills that agents and Copilot draw on across Microsoft 365, exposed to agents through the Work IQ MCP server.

workflows.label: Copilot Studio workflows
workflows.description: The visual automation experience in Copilot Studio built on the Microsoft Copilot harness; administrators care because each action consumes Copilot Studio capacity.

workforce-management.label: Workforce management
workforce-management.description: Forecasting, shift scheduling and adherence tracking for contact-centre staff; administrators care because it governs staff schedules and supervisor alerts.

worldwide.label: Worldwide (commercial cloud)
worldwide.description: Microsoft's standard commercial cloud, where most organisations are. New features reach it first.

write-actions.label: Write actions
write-actions.description: An agent creating, updating or deleting data rather than only reading it. The highest-impact kind of action.
